verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents domestic ACH and wire vendor payments: bill pay flows that route invoices to approval and payment (ramp-docs-2, ramp-docs-23), a Treasury/Checking Account offering 'unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments' and instant RTP payments (ramp-supp-checking-account, ramp-supp-bank-transfer-automation), plus API/CLI support for choosing payment methods and paying vendors end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration specifically of ACH/wire vendor payments (community evidence only covers card spend, not bank transfers) and no detail on wire cutoff times/fees beyond marketing claims.
